name: Tourism Sustainable Mobility & Accessibility Index v2

new_components.cycling_score: Share of accommodations within 400m of OSM-labelled cycling infrastructure
new_components.pedestrian_evidence_score: Share within 400m of OSM-labelled pedestrian infrastructure
new_components.tourism_proximity_score: Share within 3km Euclidean distance to an OSM named tourism destination

separate_documentary_proxies.osm_accessibility_evidence: Not included because OSM tagging is incomplete
separate_documentary_proxies.gtfs_wheelchair_boarding: Not included because only two stops have a positive tag
separate_documentary_proxies.slope: Not included because it is a route pilot, not municipality-wide

limitations: Index is a transparent screening tool, not a causal, safety or accessibility certification.
Cycling and pedestrian values reflect OSM documentation and geometry, not field audit or network continuity.
Sentiment, perceived safety, air quality, traffic and observed demand are deliberately not included.
